units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 14:25">Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 25</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 165b:20">B. Bath. 165ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ דכספא</he> small silver coins.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 166a:1">Ib. 166ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ דדהבא לא וכ׳</he> people do not use gold for small change.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:6:4">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ</cite> top [read:] <he>סמיכא גבי הדין פ׳ למחר למחר וכ׳</he> relying on it that he will collect the money (for the cow) the next day; but the next day &c.; <he>בעאי אינון פ׳</he> (not <he>בעא</he>) I want that money.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:12">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>לית לי פ׳</he> I have no money; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite> end <he>ולבתר … ונסב פְּרִיטָיךְ</he> (not <he>פריעיך</he>, <he>פרועיך</he>) after a time I shall come and get thy money (for the clothes).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3:13">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אסור למיתן פ׳ וכ׳</he> you must not put coins in your mouth; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>פריוטי</he>, read: <he>פְּרִיטוֹי</he>, v. <cite ref="O01387"><he>סְפַן</he></cite>; Pesik. Shub., p. 164ᵇ, v. <cite ref="Q02099"><he>פְּשַׁר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23-24</cite> <he>דילמא הוא בעי פ׳ יתר</he> (not <cite ref="Q01803"><he>פריטות</he></cite>) maybe he wants more money.
